name: PTRANS
recent: Perak Transit Berhad 近期持续进行股份回购，并有多名董事及高管在公开市场或闭门期内外申报持股变动。公司于8月底公布季度业绩，并宣布第三次中期股息及相应的股权登记日。
notable: 公司于2026年8月26日宣布第三次中期股息。
公司于2026年8月27日发布股权登记通知。
公司于2026年11月10日至13日连续进行股份回购。
risks: 董事 Dato' Sri Cheong Kong Fitt 于2026年10月27日表示有意在闭门期内进行交易。
高管 Mr Cheong Mun Kwong 于2026年10月及11月多次申报增持股份。
earnings: 2026年6月30日止季度营收为5376万令吉，环比增长15.8%，同比增长9.4%；净利为1515.8万令吉，环比下降2.9%，同比下降23.8%；净利率为28.2%，低于上一季度的33.6%。

recent_en: Perak Transit Berhad has been actively buying back its shares and has seen several directors and officers declare changes in their shareholdings, both within and outside closed periods. The company released its quarterly results in late August and declared a third interim dividend with the corresponding book closure date.
notable_en: The company declared a third interim dividend on 26 August 2026.
The company issued a notice of book closure on 27 August 2026.
risks_en: Director Dato' Sri Cheong Kong Fitt indicated an intention to deal during the closed period on 27 October 2026.
Officer Mr Cheong Mun Kwong declared multiple acquisitions of shares in October and November 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 53.76 million, up 15.8% QoQ and 9.4% YoY; net income was MYR 15.158 million, down 2.9% QoQ and 23.8% YoY; net margin was 28.2%, lower than 33.6% in the previous quarter.
